title: G-Safeguard: A Topology-Guided Security Lens for Robust LLM Multi-Agent Systems

defines.name: G-Safeguard
defines.definition: A topology-guided framework for detecting anomalies and remediating attacks in LLM-based multi-agent systems using a multi-agent utterance graph and graph neural networks.

problem: LLM-based multi-agent systems are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, misinformation propagation, and unintended behaviors, and existing defenses are not topology-aware or transferable across system configurations.
